concepts.gloss_en: Aramaic (Zoharic) formula: 'to attach one's thought to the World to Come' — invoked in Torah 54 as a spiritual state (of sleep/remembrance); the fuller form adds 'in totality/generality' (בכלליות)

members.note: representative; full form with qualifier בכלליות

same Zoharic phrase in the same Torah (lm1:54), here without the trailing בכלליות; likely a shorthand of the same citation, but 'in generality' is a semantically loaded qualifier so identity is not certain — human should confirm

notes: Both forms occur only in lm1:54 and cite the same Zoharic phrase. The only difference is the presence/absence of בכלליות ('in totality/generality'). If בכלליות marks a distinct aspect in this Torah, split them; otherwise they are one concept. Kept as a single concept with the shorter form tiered 'question' per under-merge caution.
